title: Demo review of a narrowband candidate near a public target star
objective: Review a synthetic narrowband candidate record and produce a conservative, auditable SETI-style assessment.

known_context: Frequency is close to the neutral hydrogen line, which is scientifically interesting but also heavily monitored.
The candidate is narrowband and above the demo SNR threshold.
No repeat detection was reported in the follow-up observation.
No raw voltage data is included in this demo task.

review_questions: Does the candidate deserve follow-up observation?
What mundane explanations should be considered first?
What evidence is missing before any strong claim could be made?
